summary: The CorrespondenceCourseSchedule module manages scheduling for correspondence courses by providing CRUD operations, search functionality, and supporting alternate language fields. It defines both the entity structure and logic to add, update, delete, and retrieve schedules associated with courses.
purpose: To facilitate the creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of schedule records for correspondence courses, including support for alternate language fields and descriptive formatting.

entities.name: CorrespondenceCourseSchedule
entities.description: Represents a schedule entry for a correspondence course.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the schedule record.

fields.name: Days
fields.description: Number of days assigned to the schedule.

fields.name: TypeDescription
fields.description: Descriptive type info; also supports alternate language fields.

fields.name: PeriodDescription
fields.description: Period description; also supports alternate language fields.

fields.name: TemplateFormatted
fields.description: Formatted string combining type and correspondence name.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Manages DB interaction and session context.

workflows.name: Add Correspondence Course Schedule
steps: Add parameters: CourseID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID.
Execute query to insert new schedule.

workflows.name: Update Correspondence Course Schedule
steps: Add parameters: ID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID.
Execute query to update existing schedule.

business_rules: Alternate language fields (TypeDescriptionAlt, PeriodDescriptionAlt) are used if sess.UseAltLanguageFields is enabled.
ID is required for update and delete operations.
validations: For updates and deletes, the schedule record must exist (verified by ID).
Days, CourseID, CorrespondenceID, PeriodCodeID must be valid and present for add and update operations.
conditions: If sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true, retrieve alternate descriptions from TypeDescriptionAlt and PeriodDescriptionAlt.
Else, use TypeDescription and PeriodDescription fields.
system_behavior: CRUD operations are executed via defined DB stored procedures.
List population uses FillList, reading from SqlDataReader and mapping fields accordingly.
Handles alternate language fields based on session context.
dependencies: DB stored procedures: CorrespondenceCourseSchedulesAdd, CorrespondenceCourseSchedulesUpdate, CorrespondenceCourseSchedulesDelete, CorrespondenceCourseSchedulesSearch, CorrespondenceCourseSchedulesSearchID
exceptions: If invalid UUIDs or IDs are provided, the DB procedure will not execute successfully.
If required parameters are missing, operations will fail.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling or exception management details.
Business rule coverage outside CRUD and alternate language not described.
No information on validation constraints for Days, PeriodCodeID, etc.
